analysis_supplier.trusted_request_binding: AnalysisPlan requires immutable analysis_request_id and trusted analysis_request_issued_at; actual caller/currentness adapter source pin pending

relay.durable_outbox: Shared local SQLite w3_core_decision_outbox/core_delivery/w3_core_counters; retry same bytes with bounded backoff, then HELD

lifecycle_dispatch.transaction: State mutation, command digest, exact receipt, and receipt outbox commit in the same SQLite transaction
lifecycle_dispatch.restart_ordering: Relay every unfinished receipt before receiving a new command; RETRY_WAIT or HELD receipt blocks new intake
lifecycle_dispatch.command_id_conflict: Terminal reject and acknowledge without emitting a receipt
lifecycle_dispatch.source_target_ref: Must equal source_id, the authoritative W1 Source.id
lifecycle_dispatch.ack: Delete inbound command only after receipt SendMessage returns HTTP 200 and MessageId; uncertain DB or transport result is not acknowledged

c01_w2_integration.source_authority: Required module:factory implementing is_registered(UUID); checked before event, replay, snapshot, and index; errors fail closed
c01_w2_integration.compatibility: Raw W2 internal wire rejected 4/4; explicit agreed-envelope mapping accepted 4/4; W2 restriction event is not deliverable at the pinned SHA

retention.published_event_retention: min(last_successful_published_at + 1209600, created_at + 2592000); replay never extends the absolute maximum
retention.user_deletion_behavior: Authenticated lifecycle consumer applies higher-epoch deletion, immediately purges event/request, persists the exact receipt atomically, and preserves first deleted_at; live Queue/Role integration pending
retention.source_retirement_behavior: command_id-bound retire_source preserves the first authoritative retired_at, rejects later supply, and persists the exact receipt atomically; live Queue/Role integration pending
retention.backup_replay_behavior: Supported backup redacts before disk write, records a capped expiry, and is quarantined; supply/relay/replay disabled. Raw snapshot restore unsupported.
